title: Southeastern General Application (Foundation Scholarships)
summary: Private donor, industry, alumni and Foundation scholarships are applied for through one general application at selu.academicworks.com. The source says the 2026–2027 application opened November 15, 2025 for current students and newly admitted students entering summer/fall 2026.
deadlineNote: No deadline is stated on this page.
note: Source lists the 2026–27 cycle; confirm the next cycle's dates with Financial Aid at (985) 549-2000.
